title: Detect and surface runner rapid-restart (crash-loop) storms
goal: Case study task db49d6c6-bdd5-4600-aaea-15a71042ae20: a hook-blocked recovery commit crashed the runner daemon on every poisoned-task claim and systemd restarted it 10,776 times before anyone noticed, because nothing tracks runner process restarts. Add restart-storm detection: have the runner send a per-process boot id with join and heartbeats, have the backend count distinct boot ids per runner in a sliding window, and when a runner exceeds a threshold (for example more than 5 boots in 10 minutes) mark it degraded or crash-looping in the runner fleet state, surface a banner in the runner UI, and emit a loud log; the flag clears when the runner stays up. Acceptance: backend tests prove the threshold trips and clears on synthetic heartbeat sequences; a runner test proves the boot id is stable within a process and fresh per process; docs describe the operator runbook (inspect journal, drain or pause the runner).
